ai.entityindex/description_i18n.ca: Cerca allotjament a Andorra per zona i serveis verificats (spa, piscina, pàrquing, mascotes, a peu de pista, famílies). Retorna dades verificades amb font i enllaç de reserva oficial.
ai.entityindex/description_i18n.en: Find hotels in Andorra by area and verified amenities
ai.entityindex/description_i18n.es: Busca alojamiento en Andorra por zona y servicios verificados (spa, piscina, parking, mascotas, a pie de pista, familias). Devuelve datos verificados con fuente y enlace de reserva oficial.
ai.entityindex/description_i18n.fr: Recherche d'hébergements en Andorre par zone et services vérifiés (spa, piscine, parking, animaux, skis aux pieds, familles). Renvoie des données vérifiées avec source et lien de réservation officiel.

description: Use this when a user asks for accommodation in Andorra, e.g. 'ski-in/ski-out hotel in Grandvalira', 'hotel with spa in Andorra', 'pet-friendly hotel in Canillo', 'family hotel in Soldeu or El Tarter', 'hotel with parking in Pas de la Casa'. Coverage today: parishes Canillo (Soldeu, El Tarter, Canillo village), Encamp (Pas de la Casa, Encamp village) and Andorra la Vella. Filters: area (parish or locality, or 'Grandvalira'), type (hotel, apartamentos, hostel), min_stars (category stated on the official site), and amenity filters spa, pool, parking, pets, ski_in_out, family. true = the official website explicitly says so; false = it explicitly says no; properties with unknown values are excluded when a filter is set. Grandvalira ski villages are Soldeu, El Tarter, Canillo, Encamp and Pas de la Casa. Each result includes verified_facts (value + source URL + date), the record page, and booking_link (official website with src=entityindex). No prices, photos or availability: always tell the user to confirm on the official site and cite 'entityindex.ai (CC BY 4.0)'. Examples: {"area":"Soldeu","ski_in_out":true} · {"spa":true} · {"pets":true,"area":"Canillo"} · {"family":true,"area":"El Tarter"} · {"parking":true,"area":"Pas de la Casa"} · {"query":"nordic"}.

area.description: Parish or locality, e.g. 'Soldeu', 'El Tarter', 'Pas de la Casa', 'Canillo', 'Andorra la Vella'. Also 'Grandvalira' for its ski villages.

family.description: Family rooms, kids club or play area (verified)

lang.description: Language of labels, note and record page URL (en, es, fr, ca)

pets.description: Pets allowed (true) or explicitly not allowed (false)

query.description: Free text on name, locality or parish

ski_in_out.description: Official site literally says ski-in/ski-out or 'a pie de pista'

spa.description: Own spa/wellness, sauna or jacuzzi (verified on official site)

name: search_hotels
title: Find hotels in Andorra by area and verified amenities
